pages.text: $(li)Use $(l)books$() instead of random enchanting. A mob farm drops many, and special mobs drop enchanted books.$(li)$(l)Duplicate books$() with the Botania Mana Enchanter, which doesn't consume the book, or a printing press.

EnderIO can target specific enchants.$(li)$(l)Super enchants$(): the questbook introduces them once you can make the first one.$(li)$(l)AbyssalCraft mass enchanting$(): up to 8 enchants at up to level 15, even ones that normally conflict.
It's the only way to combine conflicting enchants like Protection and Magic Protection.

$(l)Removing enchants:$()$(li)Enchant Extractor$(li)Void Anvil (wipes everything)$(li)Corail Tombstone disenchanting$(li)Lens of Disenchanting$(li)Draconic Evolution Disenchanter (costs XP)$(li)Industrial Foregoing Enchantment Remover (removes one at a time, in order)
$(l)Liquid XP:$() there are three kinds. Convert between them with the Industrial Foregoing Fluid Dictionary Converter. The EnderIO $(l)Experience Obelisk$() trades freely with your XP bar.
